messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — we've seen a cluster of playbook failures tied to noisy contact tags this morning. Healthscore spikes for ~140 accounts. Anyone available to triage? :eyes:

samir_data: I dug in — it's the "product_activated" tag being backfilled from an old import. 82% of accounts that flipped had no recent activity. SQL sample:
```
select account_id, max(event_ts) as last_seen, array_agg(distinct tag) tags from contact_events where tag in ('product_activated') group by account_id;
```
I'll push a sample list to the shared drive.

anya_ops: we should circuit-break the playbook that triggers onboarding nudges for accounts with last_seen > 180d. can we add a temporary reroute to manual-review? :+1:

linda_enablement: re: manual-review — can we notify enablement only for accounts that have fwd_lead = true? otherwise it's noise. Also want to capture enablement feedback in the new "onboard-feedback" field.

oliver_pm: agree. Proposal: implement adaptive-tagging thresholds: if tag backfill rate > 5% of daily ingest, set playbook threshold to 365d and route to "cleanup-ops". We'll also create telemetry: "tag_backfill_rate" and "playbook_fallback_count". Can product/analytics own these metrics?

samir_data: yes I can own metrics. I'll instrument a Datadog metric "cs.tag_backfill_rate" and a histogram for "cs.playbook_fallback_latency". ETA EOD.

maria_cs: can someone draft the playbook config change? minimal change: add condition last_seen <= {{threshold_days}} OR backfill_flag = false. Example snippet:
```
playbooks.onboarding.nudges.conditions = [
  { "last_seen_days": { "lte": {{threshold_days}} } },
  { "backfill_flag": false }
]
```

anya_ops: I'll make a quick PR to flip the reroute and add a feature flag. tagging the ops-oncall for review @devops-oncall

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: 'cs-tag-backfill-monitor' runs every 15m — owner: samir_data.

maria_cs: thanks all — linda_enablement, can you own the enablement notification rules? samir_data, drop the sample list in /drive/CS/cleanup. I'll follow up with a short runbook for recurring checks.

linda_enablement: on it, I'll also add a one-click suppression for false-positives in the console.

oliver_pm: assigning ticket CS-8123 to track adaptive thresholds + telemetry. will set milestone next sprint.

maria_cs: perfect. closing the loop here. :white_check_mark:
